row:
Join us to see our animal hospital days!
We will have many technique based videos as well as some antics of our patients and resident feline "Sunkist"
We have made a Fear Free environment to allow for the most relaxing and stress-free environment for all creatures (humans included!)
The promotion of wellness, human:animal bond, and profoundly personalized pet care are always our highest priority!
Welcome to Urban Vet!
